excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

protocol.roster_generation: uniform integer coordinate draws from a local random.Random stream; reject all-zero, consumed old-grid, and duplicate queues; preserve accepted draw order
protocol.roster_size_judgment: 512 is sufficient for an exact finite-roster confirmation because every registered state is evaluated and the claim is limited to that roster; it is not used to infer rare-state probabilities or uniform all-queue behavior.
protocol.checkpoint_execution: one cumulative count-space B&B trace per registered queue and lane count; roots and nodes are not repaid between checkpoint reads
protocol.exploratory_rule: for R32 and R64 report the earliest registered checkpoint passing the unchanged capacity and work gates; exploratory rows cannot alter the primary decision

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution checks fail
decision_rule.PRIMARY_LARGE_ACTION_CONFIRMATION_PASS: R8/K36 and R16/K72 each have a valid certificate at every roster state, alpha below eta at all three loads, and all three frozen work fractions below five percent
decision_rule.PRIMARY_R8_ONLY_PASS_STOP: only the fixed R8/K36 primary case passes
decision_rule.PRIMARY_R16_ONLY_PASS_STOP: only the fixed R16/K72 primary case passes
decision_rule.PRIMARY_LARGE_ACTION_CONFIRMATION_FAIL_S: neither fixed primary case passes its complete confirmation gate

protocol.claim_boundary: An exhaustive result over one independently generated and preregistered 512-base-queue roster for the synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 models. R32/R64 results are exploratory. This is not an all-queue theorem, failure-rate estimate, physical multi-GPU measurement, trajectory result, or deployment decision.
protocol.prohibited: ordered-action enumeration, count-vector enumeration, run-time RNG, arrivals, trajectories, server data, paper edits, and post-result changes to the roster, primary cases, checkpoints, capacity bridge, or work gate

claim_boundary: An exhaustive result over one independently generated and preregistered 512-base-queue roster for the synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 models. R32/R64 results are exploratory. This is not an all-queue theorem, failure-rate estimate, physical multi-GPU measurement, trajectory result, or deployment decision.
limitations: The roster is finite and cannot establish a uniform all-queue result.
The roster size is not used to estimate a population failure probability.
R32 and R64 were not part of the primary confirmation gate.
Synthetic lane replication does not measure physical multi-GPU interference.
next_step: Use the confirmed R8/K36 and R16/K72 cases in a separately registered trajectory transition without changing the selector or budgets.
